## Background

`gpt_dynamic_inference_tp4_pp1_ep4_16B_inference_optimized_swiglu_logitsmatch` has tracked inference comparison failures on H100 (#7700) and GB200 (#7737). Quarantine the flaky case while those failures are investigated.

## What changed

- Change its H100 scopes from `[mr, mr-github-broken]` to `[mr-broken, mr-github-broken]`.
- Change its GB200 scopes from `[mr, mr-github]` to `[mr-broken, mr-github-broken]`.
- Add explicit flaky-comparison comments with the existing platform-specific issue links.

## Details

Use the documented `-broken` scope convention to exclude the case from normal CI selection while retaining both recipe entries for re-enablement. Model configuration, golden values, comparator tolerances, and all other recipe settings are unchanged.

Related to #7700 and #7737.

## Tested

- Targeted `python3` assertions using `recipe_parser.load_and_flatten`, `filter_by_scope`, and `load_workloads`: both YAML files parse, both disabled rows remain per platform, the case is absent from 11 active scope selectors per platform and from the H100/GB200 `mr` and `L1` workload selections. Compared parsed YAML against `HEAD` before the commit and confirmed only the target scopes changed.
- `BASE_REF=main CHECK_ONLY=true SKIP_DOCS=false bash tools/autoformat.sh` — passed; no changed Python files.
- `git diff --check` — passed.
- GPU inference was not rerun; this change only adjusts recipe selection.

## Code provenance

No code copied from external repositories.
